propositions: Batched Pydantic AI tool execution violates the completion contract's requirement to serialize evidence collection and commit verdicts incrementally, causing dense multi-criterion runs to exhaust their request budget with zero banked criterion entries instead of normal PASS/FAIL outcomes.

The original completion prompt relied on untrusted ticket context and subjective evidence-sufficiency conditions to enforce banking, unable to prevent concurrent tool batches and deferred record calls.

A completion-only policy wrapper must claim atomically one governed action per run_step, count evidence responses per unbanked criterion id, and invoke provisional met=false banking at response three if still unbanked, ensuring bounded progress before exhaustion.

The finite state machine and affirmative banking sequence must be placed in authoritative system-level guidance and expressed as data-only ids in the manifest, not imperative wording in untrusted ticket context.

The held-out behavioral oracle proved the defect (0/3 trials banked all criteria within three repository calls under the unbounded mechanism) and validates the repair (2/3+ trials with policy attached; 0/3 with policy disabled).
